instructions.objective:
Open the start page of the poll app.
In the Question box, type: Double click once?
In the Options box, type Yes on one line and No on the next line.
Double-click the Create poll button once.
Wait until the poll list has updated.
Check that exactly one poll with the question "Double click once?" appears in the list. Fail if two or more appear.
